masked_share.description: Share of pixels the model masked out (sky, nothing), 0..1.

metric.description:
Whether `depth_m` (and a `metric` EXR) is in metres: always for MoGe-2, for DA3 only
with `fov_x_deg`.

fov_x_deg.description:
Horizontal field of view in degrees (recovered by MoGe-2, estimated by DA3's camera
head, or the one given).

depth_m.description:
Depth over the trusted pixels, `[min, max]`: metres when `metric`, else the model's
canonical units.

metric_scale.description: MoGe-2's metric scale (metres per unit of shifted z; 1 for DA3).

ground.description: The ground-plane fit when `camera_height_m` was given and a plane was found: `[fitted_height_m, scale, inliers]`.

load_ms.description: Milliseconds loading the model (0 when it was already resident).
